div.div:
Organizer workspace; one owner remains even if other memberships are revoked.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
owner_user_id: uuid [FK NN]
name: text [NN]
contact_email: text [NN]
contact_phone: text [?]
status: text [NN]
default 'active'
updated_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
CK1: status IN ('active','suspended')
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(owner_user_id) -> app_user(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Workspace membership, including scanner-only members.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
organization_id: uuid [FK NN]
user_id: uuid [FK NN]
status: text [NN]
default 'active'
revoked_at: timestamptz [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (organization_id, user_id)
UQ2: (id, organization_id)
CK1: status IN ('active','revoked')
CK2: (status = 'revoked') = (revoked_at IS NOT NULL)
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(organization_id) -> organization(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(user_id) -> app_user(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Organization-level capability, excluding implicit ownership.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
member_id: uuid [FK NN]
capability: text [NN]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (member_id, capability)
CK1: capability IN ('manage_profile','manage_staff','finance')
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(member_id) -> organization_member(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Expiring workspace invitation; owner configures final event permissions on acceptance.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
organization_id: uuid [FK NN]
email: text [NN]
invited_by_user_id: uuid [FK NN]
token_hash: text [UQ NN]
expires_at: timestamptz [NN]
accepted_by_user_id: uuid [FK ?]
accepted_at: timestamptz [?]
revoked_at: timestamptz [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (token_hash)
CK1: email = lower(btrim(email))
CK2: expires_at > created_at
CK3: (accepted_at IS NULL) = (accepted_by_user_id IS NULL)
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(organization_id) -> organization(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(invited_by_user_id) -> app_user(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(accepted_by_user_id) -> app_user(id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Event assignment constrained to membership in the event's organization.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
organization_id: uuid [FK NN]
member_id: uuid [FK NN]
revoked_at: timestamptz [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (event_id, member_id)
UQ2: (id, event_id)
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(event_id, organization_id) -> event(id, organization_id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(member_id, organization_id) -> organization_member(id, organization_id) [1 parent / 0..*
children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Event-level permission set; multiple capabilities per assignment.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_staff_id: uuid [FK NN]
capability: text [NN]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (event_staff_id, capability)
CK1: capability IN
('event_edit','attendees','support','reports','refund','scan','reverse_checkin','staff')
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(event_staff_id) -> event_staff(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.
